text:
Asha (PM): draft PRD attached — proposing 'Staged Microtargeting & Fallbacks' for tenant-driven rollouts. Scope: per-tenant routing weight, version pin with TTL, experiment variant matrix, automatic fallback to baseline when error rate > threshold. Need acceptance criteria and rollback triggers.

Daniel (Eng): +1. Can we standardize pin TTL? Customer asked for indefinite pin in some cases.

Asha (PM): prefer default 72h TTL, manual extend via console. Indefinite pins require a support ticket and 2nd approval.

Miles (ML Eng): metrics to track: latency_p95, error_rate (server+model), cost_per_1000_tokens, semantic_regression on canary eval set (f1/precision). Define alert thresholds: error_rate > 1% OR semantic_regression delta > 2% -> auto-fallback.

Priya (SRE): add infra signals: gpu_mem_pressure > 85% sustained 2m -> divert traffic. Also trace sample rate 100% for canary tenants for first 10m.

Daniel (Eng): 👌 example rollout config:
```yaml
rollout:
  model: model-v2-quant
  pin_ttl: 72h
  initial_split: 5%
  step_up: 15% every 30m
  fallback_policy:
    on_error_rate: 1.0
    on_latency_p95_ms: 200
    on_semantic_regr: 2.0
```

Rory (Dir PM): priority: enterprise-customers (acct: Orion Health) want earlier access. Proposed schedule: beta -> select tenants next week, wider ramp in 3 weeks. Need legal signoff for data routing.

Asha (PM): noted. We should add acceptance criteria: 1) no P0 regressions for 48h on customer traffic; 2) cost delta < 15% per-1k tokens for pinned traffic; 3) rollbacks must be automated and documented.

Priya (SRE): Who owns automated rollback playbook? Eng-oncall or Cust Success? We want a runbook + one-click revert in console.

Miles (ML Eng): I'll own the semantic regression test harness + canary eval set. Will push a test that's reproducible.

Daniel (Eng): I'll add console UI for pin extend/unpin and the API for programmatic pins.

deploy-bot: Deploy created: rollout/feature/staged-microtargeting -> sandbox

Asha (PM): Thanks all. Action items: Miles create eval + thresholds, Daniel add API, Priya write runbook draft, Rory coordinate customer readiness. We'll meet tomorrow 10am to lock schedule. :thumbsup:
